![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151148/assets/a5373ce6d1ab92c8b71feccf545a79b2515b66198ec4ffb557c9501a171b8021.png)

For the diagram shown above, which of the following statements are true?

I. The segments $\overset{―}{BC}$ and $\overset{―}{CE}$ are congruent

II. $DC=CE$

III. $BD=3\,\text{cm}$
question.worked_solution:
- Statement I is true. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{BC}$ and $\overset{―}{CE}$ have the same double hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{BC}≅\overset{―}{CE}.
$$

- Statement II is false. From the picture, the two segments $\overset{―}{DC}$ and $\overset{―}{CE}$ have different hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{DC}≇\overset{―}{CE}.
$$

Hence, $DC\ne CE.$

- Statement III is true. According to the picture, we have that $\overset{―}{BD}$ and $\overset{―}{AB}$ have the same hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{BD}≅\overset{―}{AB}.
$$

Hence, $BD=AB=3\,\text{cm}.$

Therefore, only statements I and III are true.
